title: The URDF files of the examples in CommonData_git
author: Claude-JG
description: The URDF folders of the Staubli TX2-90, the UR5 and the Franka Emika Panda are stored in CommonData_git/data/Exudyn/robotics/URDF, beside the repository, and the examples find them by a relative path and say where to download them otherwise. Decided: not in the repository and not in tmp.
